title: Vaanam Kottattum
desc: After committing a revenge killing, a man serves time in prison, but the repercussions of his crime continue to haunt his family long after.

title: Gurkha
desc: A group of ex-army officials takes innocent people at a shopping centre hostage. When a security guard of Gurkha descent learns that the captives include the woman he loves, he sets out to save them.

title: Kantara
desc: When greed paves the way for betrayal, scheming and murder, a young tribal reluctantly dons the traditions of his ancestors to seek justice.

title: IPC 376
desc: A police officer looks into an informer who can predict future murders in a mysterious way. Soon, she unearths a sinister murder mystery that leads to a shocking truth.

title: Kullanari Koottam
desc: Vetri, an unemployed young man, meets Priya and falls in love with her, but faces challenges when her father wants him to join the police force.

title: Jai Simha
desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.
